One bounded direct GET per registered page with the full browser header set: HTTP 403 on all six URLs, body exactly 5,485 B each, containing "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" four times and a tier-list-entry count of 0. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (attemptedAt 2026-10-06T21:50:16Z), which records http 403 and a null resolved date for all six icyveins pages. Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 184,377 B (mythic-plus) and 172,248 B (raiding). Parsed from the page’s own tier markup — per .tierlist container, each .tier__tier block’s .tier__title letter against its .tier__entries data-original-title labels — and reconciled against the roster shape: 40/40 rows per bracket, 40 unique specs each, zero duplicates, zero unmatched. The M+ page’s extra dungeon-difficulty tierlist was rejected by ROSTER MATCH, not by position: its eight labels (King’s Rest, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, The Blinding Vale, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs) simply fail to map. Era-verified from the body, not a literal: both pages say "Midnight Season 2" in their own prose (raid names The Venomous Abyss), both carry Devourer in the ranked list, and the only 12.1 string is a "Patch 12.1 Guides" nav tile — so seasonVerified stays "s2". A same-day recheck: this run’s letters are identical to stored in both brackets (0 moved, 0 arriving, 0 leaving) after the M+ rebuild the 17:27 UTC run merged, so no source-owned date was advanced — the pages’ own "Last Updated" lines still read 5th October 2026 (M+) and 10th August 2026 (raid), matching the stored published dates and the independent published-evidence receipt exactly, and the snapshot stays today.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76 KB … 347 KB; r.jina.ai deliberately not tried (dead on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03). Parsed the documented way: unescape \\/ across the whole document FIRST, then take the largest [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] block (never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml — the raid-Healer decoy), read each [tier-label] letter with tolerant whitespace, and resolve specs from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Per-page row counts printed and reconciled: 27 + 7 + 6 raid and 27 + 7 + 6 M+ = 80 rows, 80 unique (bracket, spec), zero unmatched, A+ present on the M+ DPS scale as expected. Era-verified from each page’s own title — all six read "for Midnight Season 2" — with Devourer present in both DPS lists, so seasonVerified stays "s2". The 12.1.5 strings on every page are Wowhead’s site-wide PTR environment switcher ("View the 12.1.5 PTR version of this page", a /ptr-2/ link), NOT a 12.1.5 preview ranking: the registered URLs are the live pages, so the refresh-tiers 12.1.5 rule does not fire. Same-day recheck: all 80 letters identical to stored (0 moved), and each page’s JSON-LD dateModified is unchanged at 2026-08-31 / 2026-08-31 / 2026-08-31 / 2026-08-28 / 2026-09-10 / 2026-09-01, agreeing cell-for-cell with the stored published dates and the independent published-evidence receipt, so no source-owned date moved.

Fetched and parsed COMPLETE through the JSON API (never the HTML prerender, never a proxy): two plain curl calls, manifest.json HTTP 200 (353 B) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200 (161,794 B). 44 blocks in the rankings file; whitelisting categoryType dps|hps|tank with sortField "lowerBound" and keyRange undefined selects exactly 3 blocks and 27+7+6 = 40 rows, all 40 classSpec keys matching the roster byte-for-byte. NOT success for two separate reasons, both upstream. (1) manifest.snapshotDate is STILL 2026-09-15 — pinned for 21 days now, with completedAt 2026-09-15T14:25:48Z — and asOf is the source’s own snapshotDate, never the run date, so the stored coverage date stays 2026-09-15 (maxAgeDays 8; that staleness is the heartbeat’s signal and must not be papered over). (2) The 2026-08-04 incident shape was checked rather than assumed: the rankings file carries Last-Modified Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:16:55 GMT, so the two steps are again out of step — but this run’s earlier 17:27 UTC nightly already merged that movement (all 40 values, at the source’s own 2026-09-15 date), so every one of the 40 lowerBound values now fetched is identical to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision. There is nothing left to ingest and no merge was performed. Letters were not read and must not be: they cluster on player count, and lowerBound is a population mean, not Murlok’s top-50 ceiling.

All 40 merged values and all 40 dates are identical to stored, so this is an unchanged same-day recheck that advanced no source-owned date. The metric name keeps "(ceiling)": it is the average rating of each spec’s own top 50 players, never popularity. node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes.

Fetched fresh and complete: all 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk, up to 3 attempts each. 23 returned charts; FOUR returned the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body on 3/3 attempts each — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Subtlety Rogue, the same four as the 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 runs (Subtlety first errored on 2026-10-03; its stored 2026-09-23 chart therefore stands, unrefreshed). Every one of the 23 reads simc_settings.tier "MID2" and simc_settings.ptr the STRING "0", so the pool stays single-tier, and each asOf was taken from the chart’s OWN timestamp (all 23 read 2026-09-30), never the run date. NOTHING WAS MERGED, because all 23 charts are byte-identical to the stored profiles at all six target counts: there is no movement to ingest. Stored pool stays 24 profiles (floor 15). NOT success because the coverage date is the data’s own 2026-09-30, six days old — normal between upstream’s roughly weekly re-sims and inside maxAgeDays 8. The 12.1.5 wholesale-adoption hold does NOT fire tonight: PHASES.livePatch is null and today (2026-10-06) is before LABEL_FLIP_DUE (2026-10-13), and nothing in this run’s evidence says 12.1.5 is live — Blizzard’s own announcement dates it October 13 NA.
